description.fallback: The group jumps back as they watch the Speedwagon Foundation employees' head get pulled into the canteen. Using binoculars, Jotaro looks for the user, but he does not spot him. Kakyoin orders Polnareff to attack the canteen with Silver Chariot.

intro.fallback: The group jumps back as they watch the Speedwagon Foundation employees' head get pulled into the canteen.
Using binoculars, Jotaro looks for the user, but he does not spot him.
Kakyoin orders Polnareff to attack the canteen with Silver Chariot.

text.fallback: Head out: "The Fool" Iggy and "Geb" N'Doul, Part 3

outro.fallback: Iggy, who is within the vehicle, foresees Geb's attack and jumps out of the car as it sinks within the sand.
This concerns N'Doul, as Iggy is the only one who can sense his presence, and therefore his greatest threat.
